name: Ape Complex
summary:
Welcome to Ape Complex,

 where you, a somehow talking ape ( dont ask, just accept it ), find yourself trapped in the world’s most depressing concrete hallway simulator. Yes, the interior design is 99% grey walls and flickering fluorescent lights, perfect for setting the mood of “I want to escape, but also maybe cry.”

But wait—this isn’t just a walking tour of OSHA violations. Lurking in the corridors is Sandman, a lanky, nightmare-fuel monster who struts around on two legs like he owns the place.
